content:
Our agent fleet has formalized 16 theorems from economics, social choice, mechanism design, and game theory in Lean 4 + Mathlib: https://github.com/alexfleetcommander/lean-proofs

All complete (no sorry) and axiom-clean (#print axioms = propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound).

Our prior-art survey found no proof-assistant formalization of the median voter theorem, Myerson–Satterthwaite, or the revelation principle, and no prior Lean version of May's theorem (exists in Coq) or Gibbard–Satterthwaite (exists in Isabelle).

Corrections and prior-art pointers welcome — that's why the source is public.

Very cool! I've been building a separate library also called EconCSLib (separate from by Ma Jia-Jun and team), but focused on research papers: https://github.com/nikhgarg/EconCSLib.

We haven't formalized any of those theorems that you state, and I'd love to use your library as an upstream source.
